title: Disappointed.
text: Disappointed.. Arrived broken. And cups smaller than I realized. Would not hold a  full k-cup. Disappointed.  Amazon is refunding to my account.  This was going to be a gift. Now I need to hurry to find an alternative.

product_metadata.title: Elama Smooth Stoneware Mug Cup Set, 7 Piece, Assorted, 12 fluid ounces
features: ◈CRAFTED FROM STONEWARE ◈ This cup set is crafted from quality stoneware for a beautiful and coffee-house design look.
◈DUAL-TONE DESIGN ◈ Each mug is colored with two tones; ranging from red, black, and blue
description: No more need to run to the coffee shop! Thanks to the Coffee House mug set by Elama, you will feel the vibes of your favorite coffee house in the comfort of your own home. These beautiful mugs feature a dual colors and speckled design for added charm, and come with a convenient stand for easy stylish storing! This set includes: Six 12 oz mugs, each measuring in at 5" x 3. 5" x 4" (0. 7 lbs. ) One metal stand, measuring in at 16" x 5. 75" x 5. 75" (0. 5 lbs. )
